description:
*“Watch out for dominant Omegas.”*

That was an unexpected warning he heard immediately after his appendix surgery. Professional baseball player Kwon Jiwon scoffs and heads home from the hospital. Having taken on the role of coach for a children’s baseball team—partly for rehabilitation and partly at his manager’s request—Jiwon happens to bump into Min Wooyoung, a senior from his high school days who was both a promising baseball prospect and his first love. Under the influence of alcohol and unstable pheromones, Wooyoung mistakes Jiwon for his estranged husband and kisses him first…

*“Wooyoung sunbae was a Dominant Omega?!”* *(Source: Bomtoon, translated)*
